evidence.quote: On August 16, 2007, after a three-day trial, appellant’s jury returned a verdict finding him guilty of the substantive offense. That same day appellant admitted the truth of the special allegations. On September 14, 2007, the court denied appellant probation, declined a defense request to strike the prior conviction allegations under People v. Superior Court (Romero) (1996) 13 Cal.4th 497 [53 Cal.Rptr.2d 789, 917 P.2d 628], and sentenced him to a total term of 26 years to life in prison.
